---
Touches: gateway/specs/endpoints/catalog.md, gateway/specs/endpoints/catalog.schema.json, gateway/specs/endpoints/metrics.schema.json, gateway/tests/test_catalog_codex.py, gateway/tests/fixtures/codex-catalog/, gateway/src/agent_gateway/codex_catalog.py
Origin: teststuffstash/homelab#3145
Class: build

---
## Deliverable
The gateway reads the enrolled codex account's model list on a schedule, keeps the last good answer as a snapshot, and serves it at `GET /catalog/codex` — the read leg and view the `opencode` and `openrouter` rails already have on the catalog page.

Island: gateway. Filed by island intake as the parity gap inside #3145's wait: two sibling rails have a catalog read leg and a `/catalog/<rail>` view under `gateway/specs/endpoints/catalog.md`; the codex rail has neither, so the account's model list is readable only by a hand probe through the gateway pod (docs/spikes/codex-subscription-rail.md §Account model evidence, 2026-10-29).

## Acceptance
1. `GW-CATALOG-CODEX` exists on `gateway/specs/endpoints/catalog.md` (requirement section, interface row, requirement index row, flow overview node) and in the `gateway/specs/README.md` index, with the key rows below grown to the boundary rows the pinned process asks for.
2. `GET /catalog/codex` answers the last good snapshot in a shape `catalog.schema.json` names (`codex_output`): per model its id, its visibility and its minimal client version, plus the source state (`fetched_at`, `age_s`, last outcome) — the row "the view's shape is the schema's" passes.
3. A failed or unparseable read keeps the last good snapshot and is counted by outcome; the snapshot survives a restart (the rows below).
4. The read goes through the rail's own credential lifecycle; the token is on no log line and in no view field (row "the token never reaches a log line").
5. `gateway_codex_catalog_*` families (age, models, refresh total by outcome, last outcome) are in `metrics.schema.json`, no `model` label.
6. Every row's fixture is the recorded account answer under `gateway/tests/fixtures/codex-catalog/` (see Unverified) — no hand-invented wire shape.

## Spec changes
Requirement: `GW-CATALOG-CODEX` on `specs/endpoints/catalog.md` — world `policy-codex`. Template: `GW-CATALOG-GO` (the refresh) and `GW-CATALOG-OR` (the view); ⚖ marks where this rail differs.

#### A good fetch lands

| description | last_good | models_read | at | outcome? | fetched_at? | models? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| a first good fetch becomes the snapshot | none | models-ok | T0 | ok | T0 | the recorded answer's ids |
| a later good fetch replaces it | fetched T0 | models-ok | T0 + 21600 s | ok | T0 + 21600 s | the recorded answer's ids |
| a hidden id is kept and marked, never dropped ⚖ | none | models-ok | T0 | ok | T0 | visible and hidden, each with its visibility |

#### A failed read keeps the last good

| description | last_good | models_read | outcome? | fetched_at? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| an upstream error keeps the last good | fetched T0 | models-503 | fetch-failed | T0 |
| a shape the parser does not know is a parse failure | fetched T0 | models-malformed | parse-failed | T0 |
| no usable credential, no fetch ⚖ | fetched T0 | models-ok, lifecycle refuses | fetch-failed | T0 |

#### What a fetch sends

| description | authorization? | client_version? | log_lines_with_token? |
|---|---|---|---|
| the read carries the rail's token and a client version that lists the visible ids ⚖ | `Bearer <the lifecycle's access token>` | a configured value, default ≥ 0.155.0 | 0 |

#### Kept across a restart

| description | stored | restart_at | age_s? | startup_delay? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a restart inside the interval refreshes nothing at start | snapshot at T0 | T0 + 3600 s | 3600 | 18000 |

#### The view's shape (codex)

| description | models_read | shape? |
|---|---|---|
| the view's shape is the schema's | models-ok | exactly the schema's required keys |

Index row: new — `GW-CATALOG-CODEX | the codex catalog | —`.
Unverified: the `/models` answer's wire shape (field names, how visibility and `minimal_client_version` are spelled, whether any field is account-identifying) — nothing under `gateway/tests/fixtures/` records it and a worker pod cannot read the account; the refresh interval (21600 s assumed from the siblings, ⚖); whether the list differs per `client_version` beyond the 0.130.0 / 0.155.0 readings of 2026-10-29.

## Out of scope
- Which ids become the codex rail's tier candidates — `CODEX_CANDIDATES`, `tiers.py --codex-candidates`, GW-MODEL-TIERS §The rulings. That rule's replacement is #3145's and waits on its ruling; this leg only makes the account's list readable.
- A stale-snapshot alert in `argocd/resources/agent-gateway/prometheusrule.yaml`, and any admission read of the view.
- `.github/workflows/gateway-image.yaml`.
